svg.title: KESTREL K-42 — spacecraft general arrangement and longitudinal cutaway
svg.desc: Original conceptual aerospace blueprint. Consistent top, port side, front, rear and offset longitudinal cutaway views at 1:100 on A0. Dimensions in metres. Includes twin engines, four propellant vessels, crew and flight decks, airlocks, docking ring, radiators, solar wings, antennas, four landing legs, cargo bay, avionics and life-support equipment.
